slice_sources.men: 1970 and 1980 censuses interpolated to November 1972; men who are citizens 18+ (Twenty-sixth Amendment) outside the eleven Southern states: white non-Hispanic US-born, naturalized citizens of any race, Black US-born, and US-born Hispanic, Asian, Native American and other; 50 states and DC; calibrated to certified 1972 returns.
slice_sources.women: 1970 and 1980 censuses interpolated to November 1972; women who are citizens 18+ (Twenty-sixth Amendment) outside the eleven Southern states: white non-Hispanic US-born, naturalized citizens of any race, Black US-born, and US-born Hispanic, Asian, Native American and other; 50 states and DC; calibrated to certified 1972 returns.
slice_sources.south-white: 1970 and 1980 censuses interpolated to November 1972; citizens 18+ in the eleven former Confederate states other than Black US-born (white non-Hispanic US-born, naturalized of any race, and US-born Hispanic, Asian, Native American and other); calibrated to certified 1972 returns.
slice_sources.black-south: 1970 and 1980 censuses interpolated to November 1972; Black US-born citizens 18+ in the eleven former Confederate states; first election with 18-year-olds voting nationwide; Voting Rights Act coverage continues. Any shortfall against white turnout is counted as exclusion.
slice_sources.immigrants: 1970 and 1980 censuses interpolated to November 1972; noncitizen adults of any race, who could not vote in any state.
